$comment: SHARED SOURCE OF TRUTH for the DSource deliverable pack.
`plan` drives BOTH the 2D plan renderer AND the workbook's Plan-sheet legend chips —
gate G4 asserts the legend chip fills equal these hexes EXACTLY.
`materials` drives the 3D render/walkthrough look and the Inventory floor/ceiling material names.
plan.*        = exact pixel values counted in xl/media/image1.png (the reference master plan PNG),
cross-checked against the workbook's custom xl/styles.xml <indexedColors> palette.
materials.*   = median of a targeted patch sampled from the 3840x2160 reference renders
(docs/reference/qbiq/media/*.png). These are AS-RENDERED under warm interior
lighting, so they read warmer than the physical swatch; the hueRange/target
fields are what gate G6 tests, not exact equality.

circulation_source.note: Drawn as pure red at alpha 25/255 (~9.8%); composites to #FFE6E6 over white.

_legendChrome._deviation: The reference's Q8 Core chip is #D5BDD6 while the plan PNG draws core as #A0A0A0. DSource unifies on #A0A0A0 so plan and legend agree; G4 enforces the unified value.

herringbone_parquet._bandEvidence: The four reference stills measure H 19.5-23.8, S 0.22-0.25, L 0.33-0.41 on their parquet bands; the ranges are widened around that envelope so lighting variation does not trip the gate while a carpet/concrete floor still would.
herringbone_parquet.usedFor: Circulation spines, reception, open-space and lounge floors. Dark-stained oak laid in a herringbone pattern; the single strongest identity move in the reference.

light_gray_carpet._bandEvidence: Conference_room's carpet band measures H 37.5, S 0.10, L 0.55.
light_gray_carpet.usedFor: Enclosed rooms: conference rooms, offices, focus rooms, workstation zones. Reads near-neutral warm gray under the render's warm key light.

sage_green_feature_wall.usedFor: Reception backdrop (with circular timber insets), open-space alcove/pod walls, and the round column drums. The one saturated accent in an otherwise neutral scheme.

perforated_bronze_screen.usedFor: Bookcase/library backs, storage-wall infill and ceiling-height room dividers. Dark bronze-anodised perforated metal; reads as a fine dot-matrix texture.
perforated_bronze_screen._bandEvidence: Measured #40261A H=18.9 S=0.42 L=0.18 on Work_stations. Ranges are widened around the measurement so lighting variation passes while a different material family does not.

white_oak_furniture.usedFor: Desks, workstation benches, bar counters, reception desk fluting, tall vertical slat screens, storage credenzas. The dominant furniture tone.
white_oak_furniture._bandEvidence: Measured across three stills: H 25.9-31.9, S 0.34-0.46, L 0.54-0.67. Ranges are widened around the measurement so lighting variation passes while a different material family does not.

black_ring_luminaire.usedFor: Suspended circular rings over reception and rectangular linear frames over open space; also the black track/pendant stems and chair bases. Matte near-black with a warm cast.
black_ring_luminaire._bandEvidence: Measured (5th-pct luminance) H 23.3-28.0, S 0.15-0.38, L 0.08-0.24. Ranges are widened around the measurement so lighting variation passes while a different material family does not.

ceiling_white.usedFor: Plasterboard soffits and bulkheads. Physically white; renders warm-off-white under the 3000K key.
ceiling_white._bandEvidence: Measured #DBCAB8 H=30.9 S=0.33 L=0.79 on Reception. Ranges are widened around the measurement so lighting variation passes while a different material family does not.

black_exposed_ceiling.usedFor: Open-plenum zones: exposed slab, blacked-out services and the white perforated cable-basket trays read against it.
black_exposed_ceiling._bandEvidence: NOT independently sampled (the four hero stills show no open-plenum zone). Ranges are inherited from upholstery_charcoal, which shares the same near-black warm family. Re-measure if a render ever features an exposed ceiling.

upholstery_charcoal.usedFor: Reception lounge tub chairs and ottomans.
upholstery_charcoal._bandEvidence: Measured #2E241D H=24.7 S=0.23 L=0.15 on Reception. Ranges are widened around the measurement so lighting variation passes while a different material family does not.

glass_partition.usedFor: Full-height framed glazing to conference/focus rooms. Slim white-painted mullions on a ~1.2 m module; the glass itself is near-clear with a faint warm reflection.

renderMood.description: Warm interior key + cool daylight through full-height glazing. Global mean luminance of the four reference stills sits in a narrow band; no crushed blacks and no blown highlights.
renderMood._bandRationale: Reference stills span 0.569-0.634. The gate band is widened to 0.40-0.78 so a legitimately darker or brighter DSource render still passes, while a black/blown/empty frame fails. minStdDev rejects flat single-colour frames.
